detail.title: Intex Cool Star HC 60 Air Cooler – 60 Litres
detail.overview: Efficient Cooling | Compact High Performance | Inverter-Compatible | Ice Chamber | 1-Year Warranty Overview The Intex Cool Star HC 60 is a compact yet powerful desert air cooler designed to deliver efficient cooling for medium-sized living spaces. Built for everyday comfort during intense summers, it offers the right balance of performance, energy efficiency, and ease of use. With a 60-litre water tank, the HC 60 provides long hours of cooling with minimal refilling, making it ideal for bedrooms, study rooms, and small living areas. Its high-efficiency honeycomb cooling pads retain 45% more water, which results in 25% extra cooling. The cooler is inverter compatible, allowing uninterrupted operation during power cuts. A built-in ice chamber adds an extra layer of cooling during peak heat, while the shock- and rust-proof body ensures durability for regular use. Easy mobility and simple maintenance make the Cool Star HC 60 a practical and reliable cooling solution for everyday home use. Product Highlights 60-Litre Water Tank for Daily Cooling Needs The adequately sized tank supports extended cooling sessions without frequent refills, ideal for daily household use. Effective Airflow for Medium-Sized Rooms Designed to deliver consistent airflow, the HC 60 ensures even cooling across bedrooms and living areas. High-Efficiency Honeycomb Cooling Pads The honeycomb pads enhance water retention and evaporation, delivering faster and more uniform cooling. Inverter-Compatible Design The cooler operates smoothly on home inverters, ensuring comfort even during power outages or voltage fluctuations. Ice Chamber for Extra Cooling The integrated ice chamber allows you to add ice for a noticeable drop in air temperature during extremely hot conditions. Durable, Rust-Proof Construction Built with a shock- and rust-resistant body, the cooler is designed for long-term performance and reliability. Ideal For: Bedrooms, study rooms, small living rooms, and compact home spaces that need efficient cooling without occupying too much floor space.
